verdict.rationale: ADK supports locally running models (docs-15) and offline or disconnected deployment with no connection to Google Cloud (docs-7). That lets a user keep data away from hosted model providers and so indirectly avoid training use. Nothing in the evidence documents a training opt-out or a data-usage policy, so this is a workaround rather than an explicit guarantee. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training data policy or opt-out control, documentation of how data is handled when using Gemini or Cloud deployments, and independent corroboration.
